title: Distribution Network for IP Addendum 2016
bodyHtml:
IP Addendum 2016 to IP 2014 is available for sale from IPC Secretariat and its distributors.

  1. IPC Secretariat:

The IP Addendum 2016 to 2014 can be procured from the office of the Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IP Commission at CIPL Campus, RajNagar, Sector 23, Ghaziabad - 201 002 (UP) through Demand Draft @ Rs. 5,000/- (Rupees Five thousand only) issued in favour of "Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission" payable at Ghaziabad.
